statement0:
The word "when" is mentioned two or more times in 36.0% of psychology papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "when" , 27.1% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This rate is similar to median Psychology paper (shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "when" are in the top 56th percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better). Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "when" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (59th percentile among all words) but tend to be cited less (26th percentile word). In general, this word is positively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are more likely to publish papers containing "when" (61st percentile).
